claims.claim_text: The 2016 Republican platform states that American businesses face the world's highest corporate tax rates.
The U.S. corporate-tax regime described as the world's highest in the 2016 Republican platform reduces American companies' ability to compete abroad.
The U.S. corporate-tax regime described as the world's highest in the 2016 Republican platform encourages American companies to relocate abroad.
The U.S. corporate-tax regime described as the world's highest in the 2016 Republican platform reduces American companies' investment.
The U.S. corporate-tax regime described as the world's highest in the 2016 Republican platform severely limits job creation in the United States.
The U.S. corporate-tax regime described as the world's highest in the 2016 Republican platform lowers American wages.
The U.S. corporate-tax regime described as the world's highest in the 2016 Republican platform encourages avoidance of tax liability.
The U.S. corporate-tax regime described as the world's highest in the 2016 Republican platform does not actually increase tax revenues.
Republicans propose lowering the U.S. corporate tax rate to equal or fall below rates in other industrial nations.

Republicans endorse the National Commission on Fiscal Responsibility and Reform and the 2016 U.S. administration's Export Council recommendation to adopt territorial taxation so profits earned and taxed abroad can be repatriated for job-creating investment in the United States.
The Republican Party regards international trade as crucial for all sectors of the U.S. economy.
The Republican Party rejects the view that massive trade deficits, like international trade, are crucial for all sectors of the U.S. economy.
